column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
a message from another session is not routed, and moves nothing in the session it lands in
a notification payload is machine text end to end
a summary request behind leading spaces is recorded as nothing too
a summary request leaves a marker for its session in place of a record
a task notification is not a prompt
and SessionEnd folds nothing of it into ledger.d
and Stop neither holds that session nor tells it anything
and a summary session is not
and an older one in which such a prompt was one of several
and counts a person's session whose prompt shares the request's first 200 characters
and keeps no route state for Stop to judge it by
and leaves no session mark for a session nobody held
and logs no routing decision for it
and names no play in a session ledger for it
and one lifecycle row for that session, of kind summary, naming its transcript
and records no hold for it in says.log or verification.log
and records nothing else for it: no brief, no route, no mark, no route state
and so is one behind an escaped leading newline
and writes no brief for it to says.log
but no longer folds an old summary session back into ledger.d
nor is a system reminder
nor the all-caps sentinel
nor the stop hook talking to itself
session-start counts a person's unfolded session as stranded, and not an old summary session
so session-end folds no phantom session into ledger.d
the #264 block leaves the logs and the session state as it found them
the platform's summary request says nothing
